entries.title: Project identity
entries.statement:
Working title: Hollow Reach
Genre / subgenre: Tactical extraction / survival strategy
Mode: Single-player

entries.title: Game vision
entries.statement: Lead expeditions from a failing geothermal settlement, turning scarce information and risky salvage into survival.

entries.title: Core loop
entries.statement: Survey a sector, choose a route and loadout, extract salvage, then invest the return before conditions shift.

entries.title: Design pillar: Information creates advantage
entries.statement: Observation and preparation should create safer options without removing uncertainty.

entries.title: Design pillar: Every haul carries a tradeoff
entries.statement: Salvage value competes with time, carrying capacity, and exposure.

entries.title: Open question
entries.statement: Who has the final claim when the Salvage Compact marks a recovery zone that an independent crew entered first?
